tasks.label: Measure static distribution
args: $bytes=(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath dist -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Files=(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath dist -Recurse -File).Count; SizeMB=[math]::Round($bytes/1MB,2); SizeGB=[math]::Round($bytes/1GB,3); Root=(Test-Path dist/index.html); English=(Test-Path dist/en/index.html)} | Format-List

tasks.label: Verify hosted asset paths
args: npm run build; $paths=@('dist/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/fullimage-placeholder-768x512.jpg','dist/wp-content/themes/ronn_square_back/dist/assets/js/block-0-1-fullimage-anim-DwOgHX7k.js','dist/wp-content/themes/ronn_square_back/dist/assets/js/block-5-1-hero-contact-anim-B2LQj4fn.js'); $paths | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{Path=$_; Exists=Test-Path -LiteralPath $_} } | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: Verify hosted asset paths
args: npm run build; Write-Output ('image=' + (Test-Path 'dist/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/fullimage-placeholder-768x512.jpg')); Write-Output ('fullimage-js=' + (Test-Path 'dist/wp-content/themes/ronn_square_back/dist/assets/js/block-0-1-fullimage-anim-DwOgHX7k.js')); Write-Output ('contact-js=' + (Test-Path 'dist/wp-content/themes/ronn_square_back/dist/assets/js/block-5-1-hero-contact-anim-B2LQj4fn.js'))
